name: Motor Power in Bounds
hint: Motor power is expressed as a percentage from 0 to 100, enabling the robot to execute movement commands reliably.
instruction: Keep every power value between 0 and 100 percent before passing it to a motor command.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
@codeyA move forward at power (50) % for (1) secs :: motion
